verses.tl: Idhaa jaa'akal-munaafiqoona qaaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolu Allaahi Wallaahu ya'lamu innaka larasooluhu Wallaahu yashhadu innal-munaafiqeena lakaadhiboon
Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo an sabeelillaahi innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Dhaalika bi-annahum aamanoo thumma kafaroo fatubi'a alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon

Wa idhaa ra'aytahum tu'jibuka ajsaamuhum wa in yaqooloo tasma liqawlihim ka'annahum khushubun musannadatun yahsaboona kulla sayhatin alayhim humul-aduwwu fahdharhum qaatalahumu Allaahu annaa yu'ufakoon
Wa idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolullaahi lawwaw ru'oosahum wa ra'aytahum yasuddoona wa hum mustakbiroon
Sawaa'un alayhim aastaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allaahu lahum innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Humul-ladheena yaqooloona laa tunfiqoo alaa man inda rasooli Allaahi hattaa yanfaddoo wa Lillaahi khazaa'inus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa laakinnal-munaafiqeena laa yafqahoon
Yaqooloona la-in raja'naa ilal-madeenati layukhrijannal-a'azzu minhal-adhalla wa Lillaahil-izzatu wa lirasoolihi wa lilmu'mineena wa laakinnal-munaafiqeena laa ya'lamoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tulhikum amwaalukum wa laa awlaadukum an dhikri Allaahi wa man yaf'al dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Wa anfiqoo min maa razaqnaakum min qabli an ya'tiya ahadakumul-mawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawlaa akhkhartanee ilaa ajalin qareebin fa-assaddaqa wa akun minas-saaliheen
Wa lan yu'uakhkhira Allaahu nafsan idhaa jaa'a ajaluhaa Wallaahu khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
